mask_rule: PCG64 uniform 8-of-22 without replacement independently per canonical CSV row; all rows; literal UNK
primary: TST minus clean-validation-selected best of Mean/Max/MeanMax MLP; all ten head seeds, all three masks
pool_selection: maximum mean per-seed clean validation Macro-F1; ties: Mean, Max, MeanMax
ewma_selection: clean validation Macro-F1; ties: ascending alpha
ewma_initialization: first probability vector of each L10 window; recurrence reset each window
vote_tie_rule: majority count, then mean probability among tied classes, then lowest class ID

inference.encoder: FP32 dynamic-padded batches; raw last-layer CLS from Step8 trained model
inference.pooling_and_LSTM: original checkpoint batch and AMP; pooling batch=2*train batch
inference.probability_controls: Step8 classifier head on the SAME FP32 Step9 CLS; not Step8 Trainer FP16 replay
inference.clean_replay: all 50 saved heads: validation and test decisions exact; original fixed probability tolerances

diagnostics.source: Hash-bound existing raw companions: actual minus paired-nominal 22 fields
diagnostics.metrics: Descriptive accuracy and per-class recall with endpoint/episode support, plus last retained lag 0..9
diagnostics.extra_group: Current projection change masked but some history change retained

supplement.reference: Original Step8 classifier at current L10 endpoint, not TST L1
supplement.omission: Remove only selected clauses, preserve field order and all other values; no new special tokens
supplement.contrasts: TST minus selected pooling and current-window classifier in both serializations
supplement.statistics: 20,000 paired class-stratified episode draws; 95% and four-contrast Bonferroni 98.75% intervals; supplementary

statistics.unit: class-stratified whole episode; same draw for all models, seeds, masks and clean condition
statistics.estimand: mean of per-head-seed six-class Macro-F1s, then mean of three masks; no probability ensemble
statistics.ci: 95% linear percentile, conditional on encoder, trained heads, three masks and generator realization
statistics.multiplicity: one validation-selected primary contrast; seven-comparator Bonferroni intervals supplementary
statistics.population: all eligible L10 endpoints, including contexts with no observed clean projection change
